career_ladder.note: Head Constable (Ministerial) is the foundational clerical and administrative rank in the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Personnel manage office records, personnel files, finance/accounts, and logistical documentation in Group Centres, Battalions, and Directorate General offices. Progression through ministerial ranks culminates in induction into Group 'A' Gazetted status.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment is conducted across four sequential stages: Stage 1 Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 objective questions across 4 sections (90 minutes); Stage 2 Skill Test (Typing test on computer for HC Ministerial); Stage 3 Physical Standard Test (PST) and Document Verification (DV); Stage 4 Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME).

financial_package.note: Head Constable (Ministerial) in CRPF is placed in Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100) under the 7th Central Pay Commission. Being ministerial staff, personnel are primarily deployed in administrative headquarters and establishments.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian & CAPF Personnel), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790), HRA (10% to 30%), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,965/month) where admissible, minus NPS deduction.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / messing facilities across CRPF establishments
Hair Cutting / Soap / Toilet allowance and Annual Dress Allowance (₹10,000 per annum)
Free medical care for employee and eligible family members through CRPF Composite Hospitals
Subsidized consumer goods purchasing through Central Police Canteen (CPC) facilities
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
Government quarter allocation in CRPF Group Centres and family residential quarters
